## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] The [INTENTION.md checklist](https://github.com/lggarrison/agent-skills/blob/main/INTENTION.md#checklist-for-a-new-or-changed-skill) holds for every new or changed skill
- [ ] README table updated if a skill was added, renamed, or its use changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `Unreleased`
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data committed
